description: This file defines the AnalyticsManager class responsible for managing analytics tracking within the app. It includes singleton pattern implementation, constants for event and parameter names, and methods for logging various user interactions and events.

classes.name: AnalyticsManager
classes.description: A singleton class that manages analytics tracking, providing methods to log different types of user interactions and app events.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of AnalyticsManager, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: logEvent
methods.description: Logs an event with a name and optional parameters.

methods.name: logScreenView
methods.description: Logs a screen view event with the name of the screen.

methods.name: logLeaveMarked
methods.description: Logs an event when a leave is marked, with the specified leave type.

methods.name: logBackup
methods.description: Logs the result of a backup operation, success or failure.

methods.name: logRestore
methods.description: Logs the result of a restore operation, success or failure.
